title: Split Reality Alchemist
description: A split-image surreal artwork shows a man in a lab coat standing at the center, divided vertically between a light left side and dark right side. He holds a red atomic orb in his right hand and a purple cosmic orb in his left, framed by a glowing circular portal against a background of mountains, geometric symbols, and celestial patterns.
prompt: Surreal split-image artwork of a man in a lab coat standing at the center of a glowing circular portal. His body is vertically divided: the left side is light with detailed line art of mountains, a hiker, and a red atomic orb held in his right hand; the right side is dark with geometric patterns, a purple cosmic orb in his left hand. The background features contrasting landscapes with celestial symbols, planets, and abstract shapes in black and off-white ink.
